title: Journal candidates — decision matrix
topic: Urban flood nowcasting from weather-radar rainfall (dual-pol S-band) versus rain-gauge rainfall, feeding a machine-learning model for a flood early warning system; case study in the Mooca/Tamanduatei sub-basin (Sao Paulo, Brazil).

criteria.label: Impact Factor
criteria.measures: Most recent JCR impact factor available, normalized against the highest IF in this candidate set.

criteria.label: Publishing cost / agreements
criteria.measures: 0-10, set by the author: 10 = APC fully covered by an agreement the author's institution actually holds; 4 = no agreement found (author pays or publishes closed); 1 = publisher the author has decided to avoid.

criteria.label: Special issue fit
criteria.measures: 0-10: 0 = no open special issue on topic; ~6 = broad-scope issue that would accept the paper; 8-9 = issue whose call names this paper's exact subject.
